intent: SCALE: 60 pie slices with showData. mermaid ships only 12 pie palette entries (pie1..pie12) and mermaidPlugin.ts overrides NONE of them, so the palette recycles 5 times - adjacent slices become indistinguishable and slice labels collide. This is the wave's explicit palette-recycling-at-scale probe; slice fills come from engine internals and must be judged visually, not computed.
